text:
liz: Quick heads-up — webinar + launch traffic looked great but SFDC MQLs didn't move. Dashboard sessions +300% yet MQL count flat. Can someone triage before Monday's KPI readout?
omar: Noted. Is the drop between sessions->leads or leads->MQLs?
beth: I pulled the funnel; sessions->registrations up, but registrations->sales_leads is where numbers diverge. Looks like ~18% of registrations never appear in Salesforce.
samir: That smells like our lead router or the SF connector mapping. We changed a field name last week (campaign_id -> campaign_ref). Could be a mismatch.
liz: Good call. crm-bot: connector status check please.
crm-bot: SF Connector last sync: 2026-05-02T09:10:12Z. Recent failures: 124 records failed to upsert in last 12h, error: Unknown field 'campaign_id'.
beth: There it is. Registration payloads still include campaign_id, but SF expects campaign_ref. Hence leads rejected and never become MQLs in the dashboard.
omar: Can we patch the router to map campaign_id -> campaign_ref on the fly? That should recover most leads quickly.
samir: I'll open a hotfix. Quick patch plan: add mapping layer in router (campaign_id -> campaign_ref) + retry queue for failed upserts. Will PR and roll to canary.
liz: Also we need a retroactive join to count the lost leads in the KPI dashboards. beth, can you backfill the failed upsert logs into our analytics so the weekly KPI has corrected numbers?
beth: Yes. I can ingest the connector failure queue, match by registration_id, and mark leads_received_upstream. Small SQL I ran to confirm scope:
```
select count(*) as failed_upserts
from sf_upsert_failures
where occurred_at > now() - interval '36 hours'
  and error ilike '%Unknown field%';
```
result: failed_upserts = 124. Of those, 96 have complete registration events and emails. Likely recoverable.
samir: Hotfix PR: https://git.company/router/pull/782 — mapping added and retry worker. Tests pass. Rolling to canary.
crm-bot: PR merged and canary deployed (sha: 4f9b2). No errors in canary.
analytics-bot: Adding derived metric: delayed_sfdc_ingest = failed_upserts / registrations. Will surface on KPI and set an alert at >5%.
liz: Great. beth — can you run the backfill report and produce pre/post KPI snapshots for the Monday deck? Leadership wants a short note explaining the discrepancy.
beth: Backfill job started (job id bf-31111-01). ETA ~3h. I'll push interim CSV to /reports/sfdc_backfill_3111112345_partial.csv and snapshot the KPI page before/after.
omar: Once backfill completes, make sure to include a small table in the deck: recovered_leads, delta_MQL_rate, and root_cause = connector field mismatch. Keep it one slide.
samir: Noted — added a step to the release checklist: "verify SF field mappings after schema changes". Also added an automated schema diff alert to #eng-oncall.
crm-bot: Retry worker processed 92 of 124 failed records, 87 succeeded, 5 still failing due to email format validation.
beth: Backfill partial: matched 90/96 recoverable regs; expecting final adjusted MQL +3.2 percentage points after conversions reflow. Uploaded pre-snapshot: https://app.company/dashboards/kpi/snapshots/3111112345_pre.png
liz: Thanks. For the 5 failing records, let's surface them to sales ops for manual follow-up. samir, can you add them to the SF ops queue?
samir: Done — queue link: https://app.company/ops/queues/sf-manual/3111112345. Also opened follow-up PR to add automated validation for campaign field names in staging.
analytics-bot: Backfill complete: 88 of 96 recoverable matched and reingested. Adjusted weekly MQL delta: +2.9pp. Post-snapshot: https://app.company/dashboards/kpi/snapshots/3111112345_post.png
liz: Solid. We'll include the before/after and one-line root cause in the KPI deck: "Initial undercount due to SF connector schema mismatch; hotfix deployed and backfill applied — +2.9pp MQL recovery."
omar: Also recommend we add a dashboard tile: "sfdc_ingest_failure_rate" with a 2% alert threshold. That'll catch regressions earlier than the funnel.
beth: Added tile and alert; analytics-bot created rule: marketing.sfdc_ingest_failure_rate > 0.02 -> notify #marketing #eng-oncall.
samir: Closing the loop — patch merged to main and staging schema diff monitor enabled. Leaving this thread as canonical. :thumbsup:
